amendment_reason: The preregistered 50% full-crop gate admitted zero of seven conservatively labelled negative crops. Before any model predictions, retain identical acquired imagery, review files and checkpoints, and require at least 5% of native crop pixels (5120 pixels, 51.2 square metres) of agreed background for exploratory pixel diagnostics. No label expansion, candidate backfill or performance-based selection.
evaluation_policy: Both fixed checkpoints once at threshold0.5; supervised-background pixel FP/TN and per-crop diagnostics, ignored predictions unscored. No IoU/Recall or roof-level false-positive/prevalence claim.
limits: Three small geographic convenience samples; not representative.
AI label errors may be correlated; no human-reviewed benchmark truth.
Spatial separation from declared data does not establish independence from unknown ImageNet pretraining sources.
No model, seed, threshold, sampling or annotation tuning from these holdout predictions in this experiment.
review_policy: Two separate AI visual inspections of every complete native crop, blind to each other and model predictions. Recognizable PV anywhere or unresolved roof collectors defer the whole crop. Only mutually approved background polygons supply labels; trees, occlusion and unresolved non-roof areas remain ignored. Both approve and >=5% consensus background required for evaluation.
selection_policy: Geometry, stable building IDs and geographic exclusion only; no model-based selection, no filling quota after PV review or failed metadata.
